descriptions.preferred: This good, strong dwarf shrub has large seven-lobed leaves. In fact, the leaves are surprisingly large for a dwarf. Strong growth produces foliage 7 cm long and more than 11 cm wide. The long lobes radiate out well, with the leaf base somewhat truncate. The lobes are strongly ovate-lanceolate with long, tapering points, separated two-thirds of the way to the leaf base, and are well notched at the margins. Old wood inside the plant produces somewhat smaller leaves. The color of the foliage is strong green with bronzed edges and tips, and the texture is neither weak nor thin. Fall color is yellow with reddish hues but not outstanding. High fertility causes excessively long shoots, making for unbalanced plants. When grown with moderate moisture and fertility, the leaf nodes become more compressed along the shoots. This cultivar enjoys some popularity with bonsai enthusiasts and has been widely used for this purpose. It is also attractive in the right place as a dwarf in the landscape. rhs.description: A compact, deciduous dwarf tree about 1m in height, forming a mound of long 7-lobed green leaves edged and tipped bronze, the leaves becoming yellow tinted red in autumn; ideal for containers or bonsai

attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dwarf group are compact and slow-growing, making them ideal for pots and containers

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits bonsai cultivation and containers . See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , only from late autumn to mid-winter
care.propagation: Propagate by softwood cuttings, layering or by grafting . Plants grown from seed are unlikely to come true, but may still be garden worthy

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to aphids and scale insects , including horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 紧凑型落叶矮生小乔木，高约 1 米，形成圆 mound 状株形；叶片绿色，通常为细长七裂，叶缘及叶尖带古铜色，秋季转为带红晕的黄色。非常适合容器栽培或制作盆景。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园，乡村/自然式花园，露台/容器植物，花境及花坛
attributes.hort_group_description: 这一矮生类群的 Acer 株形紧凑、生长缓慢，因此非常适合盆栽和容器栽培。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保湿性好且排水良好的土壤中，并置于避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度能稳定保持，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度都可能导致叶片灼伤。适合盆景栽培及容器栽培。参见 Japanese maples cultivation。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1，仅限晚秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可通过嫩枝扦插、压条或嫁接繁殖。实生苗通常难以保持品种性状，但仍可能具有园艺观赏价值。

resistance.pest: 可能易受蚜虫和介壳虫侵害，包括七叶树介壳虫。
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这是一种优良而健壮的矮生灌木，具大型七裂叶。事实上，就矮生品种而言，其叶片大得令人惊讶。生长旺盛时，叶长可达 7 厘米以上，叶宽可超过 11 厘米。细长的裂片向外舒展良好，叶基部略呈截形。裂片为明显的卵状披针形，先端长渐尖，裂至叶基约三分之二处，边缘具明显缺刻。植株内部老枝所生叶片则略小。叶色为浓绿色，叶缘与叶尖带古铜色，叶质不薄弱，也不纤细。秋色为带红调的黄色，但并不十分出众。肥力过高会导致新梢徒长，使株形失衡。在中等湿度和肥力条件下栽培时，枝条上的叶节会更为紧凑。该品种颇受盆景爱好者欢迎，并已广泛用于盆景栽培。在景观中，如配置得当，也是一种出色的矮生品种。‘Aoba jo’ 也曾以 ‘Aoba bo’ 和 ‘Aoba cho’ 之名流通，另也拼作 ‘Aoba joh’。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Aoba jo' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Aoba jo' Beautiful Green Dwarf Japanese Maple Zones 5-8 ‘Aoba jo’ is a unique dwarf Japanese maple with tight internodes. Yes, the overall shape is very “Mikawa-like”. The leaves are less elongated than ‘Mikawa yatsubusa’, and are rounder. The leaves on ‘Aoba jo’ are less uniform, as some leaves are flat while other leaves may cup downward slightly. In the spring, ‘Aoba jo’ leafs out as a bronze, turning to bronze red-tipping by mid-spring on a brighter chartreuse leaf. By late spring the leaves mature to a dark green. In the fall, ‘Aoba jo’ turns to a bright yellow with orange to red highlights. ‘Aoba jo’ may reach 3-4 ft in height and width in 10 years. Give ‘Aoba jo’ protection from the hot afternoon sun for best growth.
